data.name: Charles
data.gender_notes: Charles is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic karl, 'free man'. Its root is Germanic karl. Saint Charles Borromeo; Charlemagne. Charles is a Germanic name meaning “Free man”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Charles expresses “Free man”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charles total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
